add_col () {
  agent-browser click e9 >/dev/null 2>&1
  sleep 0.2
  # snapshot to get input + Add button refs
  snap=$(agent-browser snapshot -i -c 2>&1)
  inp=$(echo "$snap" | grep -iE "textbox|Column name" | grep -oE "ref=e[0-9]+" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  # type name
  agent-browser fill "$inp" "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1
  addbtn=$(echo "$snap" | grep -E "button \"Add\"" | grep -oE "ref=e[0-9]+" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  agent-browser click "$addbtn" >/dev/null 2>&1
  sleep 0.2
}
